subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a privileged bootstrap-instruction source that overrides the configured workspace, or should OpenClaw preserve workspace-only authority and warn about misplaced files?
rationale: Both behaviors are plausible product choices, but they have different compatibility and security consequences; current docs and runtime establish workspace-only authority, so automation cannot safely redefine precedence.

options.title: Preserve workspace authority
options.body: Keep bootstrap injection workspace-only and add an actionable warning for standard bootstrap files found in `agentDir`.

options.title: Adopt two bootstrap roots
options.body: Explicitly define `agentDir` override precedence, migration and trust semantics, documentation, and live upgrade proof before merging the capability.

recommendation.title: Preserve workspace authority
recommendation.body: Keep bootstrap injection workspace-only and add an actionable warning for standard bootstrap files found in `agentDir`.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc most recently merged and reviewed the shared bootstrap discovery/cache path and its security-precedence concerns.
